X_layers.description: The X-check round of one syndrome-extraction cycle: 12 entangling layers, listed in the order they are executed. A layer is one global entangling pulse; it lists the block moves that fire in it. Each move gives its CZ gates as [i, j] = [row i of Hx.npy (the X check qubit), column j of Hx.npy (the data qubit)].

Z_layers.description: The Z-check round of one syndrome-extraction cycle: 12 entangling layers, listed in the order they are executed. A layer is one global entangling pulse; it lists the block moves that fire in it. Each move gives its CZ gates as [i, j] = [row i of Hz.npy (the Z check qubit), column j of Hz.npy (the data qubit)].
